target: Only missed visible abrasion in low-resolution input.
factor: Add the unchanged high-resolution physical-damage verifier only to positive outputs of the low-cost 256-token abrasion cue. The cue and verifier are existing measured components; no prompt or weight changes.
budget: 2500ms combined optional work per photo, 2600ms observed allowance including scheduler noise. Original findings and metadata remain unchanged. At most two extra calls; second only after a positive cue.

gates.requiredRepairs: First-user small320 miss plus at least one other previously missed damaged variant; subsequent independent-repeat check must retain the repair.
gates.preservePositive: Every baseline nonempty finding list, clarity, category, material and mechanism must remain unchanged.
gates.falseAlarm: No new finding on a visually negative control, including fresh-source controls.
gates.authority: No rescued finding becomes clear or claims a sliding mechanism; no category/material/identity change.
gates.latency: At most one extra request per eligible photo; p95 additional runtime <=2500ms on this host; 4s timeout preserves baseline on failure.

limits: Measured cue results from the preceding run are reused; measured new verification time is added. A fresh end-to-end repeat is mandatory before activation. Correlated development variants, not general accuracy.
